name: math-paper-skills
description: Skills for mathematics-paper writing, explicitly delegated independent exposition review, and Kicho-managed paragraph-ID workflows.

interface.longDescription: Draft and revise mathematics papers, perform explicitly delegated independent exposition review, and use Kicho-managed paragraph-ID workflows. The writing and reading skills share portable guidance and are installed together. Paragraph-ID commands and release cleanup require Kicho with its paraids command. Optional corpus tools use owner-designated input; no private corpus is bundled. Exposition review and software checks do not certify mathematical proofs.
defaultPrompt: Use the writing skill to revise a mathematics manuscript while preserving its mathematical content.
Run an explicitly delegated independent exposition review of a frozen mathematics manuscript.
Set up stable paragraph IDs in my LaTeX manuscript.
